name: local-remote-mcp
description: Primary Local Remote MCP for project-authorized file, search and terminal control. Global routing may fall back to the hosted Official Remote MCP only for same-target Local availability/capability failures.

interface.longDescription: Use Local Remote MCP as the primary machine-control path. Every local tool call is re-authorized through local .control; same-target Official fallback is governed separately by L1 routing policy.
